description: The next elections in one country, however far ahead: polling day and whether it is declared, still tentative, or only expected within a period, what is elected, the counting authority, and when results are expected. Answers "When is the next election in Austria?" or "When are the US midterms?". National elections by default; level "regional" answers "When are the next state elections in Germany?". Covers 390 elections in 100 countries, 2021–2030, including 23 of the 27 EU member states, the 2026 US midterms in all 50 states and the certified 2024 US presidential result, with vote counts, in all 50 states and DC.

count.description: How many upcoming elections to return, soonest first; default 3

country.description: Country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. "Austria" or "AT", "United States" or "US"

level.description: national: the country votes; regional: a state, region or autonomous community elects its own parliament or head (German Länder, Spanish autonomous communities, Italian regions). Default national; the answer also counts upcoming regional elections

name: next_election

meta.description: What this answer was built from; cite dataset_version

date.description: Polling day (YYYY-MM-DD); for an expected date, the last day of date_window

date_status.description: declared, tentative, or expected (no day set yet: see date_window)

date_window.description: Only for date_status "expected": the period polling day is expected in

label.description: How we name the period, e.g. "Q2 2029"

exit_poll.description: When is the exit poll? An exit poll is a survey of voters leaving polling stations, never an official result

at.description: The one time to show: when it was published, else when it is due (UTC ISO)

ban_ends.description: While a verified ban is in force: at (UTC, polls close), local, citation, scope (publication: all polls; exit-polls: exit-poll results only)

basis.description: What the expectation, or the finding that none is published, rests on

checked_at.description: For none: when that was checked (YYYY-MM-DD)

observed_at.description: When it was published, once observed

observed_source.description: Page that shows the publication, once observed

publisher.description: Who publishes it, e.g. a broadcaster and its pollster

race.description: The race the answer is recorded on

status.description: expected (due), past (due time has passed, publication not observed), published (observed), none (checked: no exit poll is published), or unknown (not yet recorded)

last_verified_at.description: When the record was last checked against its sources

poll_blackout.description: Whether opinion polls for this election should be shown only behind a warning right now, checked at request time. reason "ban": a poll-publication ban applies under the cited law. reason "unverified": we hold no verified rule for this country, so we cannot say publishing is allowed; it is not a finding that polls are banned. Show polls behind a warning (mode warn) or not at all (mode withhold)

active.description: Show polls only behind a warning now (see reason)

citation.description: The law and provision behind an active or upcoming ban

date_tentative.description: Polling day is not declared yet, so these times may move

ends_at.description: When the ban or warning ends: the last polls close (UTC ISO)

ends_at_local.description: The same moment in local time, with offset

mode.description: warn: polls may be shown behind a warning; withhold: do not show them

reason.description: ban (a verified ban applies), unverified (no verified rule; warning until polls close), or null

law.description: The law, by its own title

legal.description: Quote, English gloss, what it covers, whether it covers online publication, exemptions, penalty, enforcer

source.description: Official text the rule was read in

verified_at.description: When the rule was last read against the source (YYYY-MM-DD)

starts_at.description: When the ban starts (UTC ISO); null if the law sets none or no rule is known

verified.description: We hold a rule for this country read against the law

expected_stage_now.description: Count stage expected on the authority page now

results.description: Published counts we hold, oldest first (empty until a count is recorded)

ballot_name.description: Name on the ballot, as the authority's file writes it

source.description: File or page the numbers were copied from

stage.description: Count stage of this version, e.g. final-result

total_votes.description: Total votes cast in the race

turnout.description: Percent of registered voters who cast a ballot

figures_in_html.description: For a results page: whether its own HTML shows a count (false: figures load by script or the page only links on; null: not read)

kind.description: race_results, feed, results_index, emb_home, directory or media

kindReason.description: Why it was classified that way

oracle_reads.description: Settlement-oracle lab reads of this URL: right, wrong, unread, lab, at

resolvable.description: Can this page answer a results question?

items.description: Expected window for one count stage

confidence.description: announced (law or authority), precedent (last election) or estimate

observedAt.description: When the authority actually published it; null until observed

replacedAt.description: When a later stage replaces it on the authority page

source.description: Source of a stage published outside the authority page

stale.description: Not re-verified recently, or a stage is overdue

status.description: Where the election is now: scheduled, counting, finalising, final-expected, ...

subdivision.description: ISO 3166-2 code of the state or region, if the election belongs to one

subdivision_name.description: Name of that state or region

note.description: Set when nothing is listed yet

regional_upcoming.description: Upcoming regional elections in this country (with level national); ask again with level "regional"

total_upcoming.description: All upcoming elections we list for this country at this level

title: Next election in a country
